mapper.select: SELECT f.fair_id FROM fairs f WHERE f.canceled_at IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM fair_cancel_refund_enumerations e WHERE e.fair_id = f.fair_id ) ORDER BY f.canceled_at LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fair_cancel_refund_targets (fair_id, payment_id, payment_type, status, attempt_count, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{fairId}, #{paymentId}, #{paymentType}, 'PENDING', 0, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT fair_cancel_refund_target_id, fair_id, payment_id, payment_type, status, attempt_count, last_error, created_at, updated_at FROM fair_cancel_refund_targets WHERE status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY fair_cancel_refund_target_id LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
